run_habitat_env_example: run the habitat environment example that creates an env, resets it, and steps through random actions until the episode ends
create_habitat_env_with_config: create a habitat.Env instance using habitat.get_config to load a YAML config file for the rearrange pick benchmark
reset_habitat_episode: reset the habitat environment to start a new episode and return initial observations
step_habitat_env_random_action: step the habitat environment by sampling a random action from env.action_space and recording observations
check_habitat_episode_over: check the env.episode_over property to determine if the current habitat simulation episode has finished
